svg.aria-label: Warrant v5 architecture. The same fixed pipeline as v4. Every model call now passes one call guard (a span per attempt, rate caps, a circuit breaker, budgets, loop detection). The compare step runs on an open-weight model on Together AI, can state its arithmetic as claims that code rechecks, and every step is traced to Arize Phoenix, where runs are compared as experiments and scored by code and by two open-weight judges.
svg.text: WARRANT GATE: A FIXED LANGGRAPH PIPELINE, NO CYCLES
